reason: The definition only restates difficulty as being difficult, without explaining effort or obstacles.
The definition only restates variability as being subject to variation, without independent explanatory content.
The definition repeats probable and conflates the likelihood property with a probable event, without independently explaining either sense.
The definition only restates irreproducibility as being unreproducible, without explaining inability to repeat a result.
The definition only restates expressiveness as being expressive, without explaining the conveyed emotion or meaning.
The selfishness gloss requires stinginess, although disregard for others in pursuit of personal welfare need not concern giving or possessions.
The definition requires not showing fear; courage can coexist with expressed fear.
The definition only restates infidelity as being unfaithful, without explaining the relationship or breached commitment.
The definition only restates inhibition as being inhibited, without explaining restraint or suppression.
The serenity gloss requires freedom from emotion, although calm dispositions can include emotions; it conflates tranquility with emotional absence.
The definition only restates fit as the manner in which something fits, without explaining compatibility or dimensions.

The gloss restricts viscosity to liquids, although gases also have viscosity; unsuitable as a general physical definition. See https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/gas-properties-definitions/.

The gloss defines hue solely by dominant wavelength, which does not exist for purple stimuli; it presents a restricted colorimetric case as general. See https://ies.org/definitions/dominant-wavelength-of-a-color-stimulus/.
The skin-color gloss includes bruising as an unexplained cause of pallor, conflating discoloration with loss of color; remove this imprecise historical medical formulation.
The gloss combines maleness and masculinity under properties characteristic of male sex, obscuring the distinction between sex characteristics and gendered traits.

The cold gloss says absence of heat, conflating relative low temperature with absence of thermal energy or heat transfer. See https://www.nist.gov/si-redefinition/kelvin/kelvin-thermodynamic-temperature.

Comparatively small weight is not weightlessness; weightlessness concerns absence of apparent supported weight, including free fall. See https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilities/glenn/what-is-microgravity/.
The definition merely restates the headword as mortal without explaining susceptibility to death.
The mathematical symmetry gloss only describes reflection in a line or plane, excluding rotational and other symmetries; an unjustified restriction in this unrestricted mathematical sense.
The favorable-cases ratio requires equally likely finite outcomes; the unrestricted probability gloss omits this condition. See https://math.mit.edu/~sheffield/440/Lecture5.pdf.

The radiation gloss defines intensity as an amount of energy, omitting the time and area dependence needed to distinguish intensity from energy. See https://iupac.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/IUPAC-GB3-2012-2ndPrinting-PDFsearchable.pdf.
The definition only restates increase as the amount by which something increases, without explaining the positive difference between quantities.
The gloss embeds a dated usage prescription favoring in behalf over on behalf for benefit, rather than providing a clear standalone lexical sense.
